Next year marks the 20th anniversary of the iPhone, and rumours suggest the iPhone Pro models will feature a completely refreshed design. The latest leaks have revealed larger screen sizes said to make an appearance next year.

iPhone Pro Models Next Year to Come with Larger 6.4-inch and 7-inch Displays

In 2017, on the iPhone's 10th anniversary, Apple prepared a very special model: the iPhone X.

There are rumours the company is preparing something equally unique for next year's 20th anniversary.

According to reports, next year's iPhone Pro models will adopt a bezel-less, four-corner curved display with the screen extending to the edges of the body.

The opening for the Dynamic Island may be reduced or even removed, giving the device an all-glass, seamless monolithic appearance.

According to the latest post by leaker Digital Chat Station, Apple will also introduce new screen sizes. He says the company is testing the following specifications:

  • iPhone Pro: 6.4 inches, up from the current 6.3 inches
  • iPhone Pro Max: 7 inches, up from the current 6.9 inches

He added that both devices will have larger bodies, but will maintain the same aspect ratio as the current models. This suggests the larger screens are not simply a result of slimmer bezels.

The last time Apple adjusted the screen sizes of its Pro models was in 2024, when the iPhone 16 Pro went from 6.1 inches to 6.3 inches, and the Pro Max went from 6.7 inches to 6.9 inches.

Although next year's size adjustment sounds modest, the four-corner curved design should make for a more striking overall look.

What do you think of the rumoured design for next year's iPhone Pro models? Let us know in the comments.
